steps.message:
Analysis: AESEV is ordinal 1-4. expect_interact is binary, patients_seen has 3 levels, TRTGRP binary. Now I'll merge and run ordered logit.
Plan: Merge AE with DM on USUBJID, encode categories, run OrderedModel.

arguments.keystrokes:
cat > /workspace/notebook.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.miscmodels.ordinal_model import OrderedModel

ae = pd.read_csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_AE.csv')
dm = pd.read_csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_DM.csv')

# Merge
df = ae.merge(dm[['USUBJID','patients_seen','expect_interact','TRTGRP']], on='USUBJID', how='left', suffixes=('','_dm'))

# Drop missing AESEV
df = df.dropna(subset=['AESEV','patients_seen','expect_interact','TRTGRP'])
print('After dropna:', df.shape)

# Encode categories as numeric
df['expect_interact_cat'] = (df['expect_interact'] == 'Yes').astype(int)
ps_map = {'1-50':0, '51-100':1, '>100':2}
df['patients_seen_cat'] = df['patients_seen'].map(ps_map)
df['TRTGRP_cat'] = (df['TRTGRP'] == 'BCG').astype(int)
df['AESEV_int'] = df['AESEV'].astype(int)

print(df[['AESEV_int','expect_interact_cat','patients_seen_cat','TRTGRP_cat']].head())
print('AESEV counts:', df['AESEV_int'].value_counts().sort_index())

X = df[['expect_interact_cat','patients_seen_cat','TRTGRP_cat']]
y = df['AESEV_int']

model = OrderedModel(y, X, distr='logit')
res = model.fit(method='bfgs', disp=False)
print(res.summary())
print('\nOdds Ratios:')
or_table = pd.DataFrame({'coef':res.params,'OR':np.exp(res.params)})
print(or_table)
EOF
python /workspace/notebook.py
